task: cost of a typed default before any instruction implements footprint(params)
scope: the shipped_sound_cache_replay corpus and key policy, re-run twice: once with the replay's exact footprints, once with every admission forced to the coarse token so that any landed write flushes the run-scope cache. Only the footprint differs.
reading: A typed default without footprint() implementations is sound but pays the coarse eviction on every landed write. This is the cost of flipping the default *today*; it is a hit-rate cost, not a correctness cost, and it disappears site by site as footprint() is implemented.
